notes.title: Demo Update 0.20.1b94b3d
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

The next demo update is now available. I have added some new features like bonus resources and general tasks. If you like the demo so far, I would really appreciate a review. It helps me a lot. Thanks.

Best regards,
Stefan

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Add resource bonus cells for yield increase
[*] Add tasks for yield increase and bonus points
[*] Change turn duration behavior
[*] Add UI for resource yields and consumptions
[*] Add possibility to delete a tile if it is not placeable
[*] Save player UI preferences in Steam cloud
[*] Improve balancing
[*] Performance optimizations
[*] General improvements
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.19.b8560f9
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Many thanks to all of you who played my demo and gave feedback. I really appreciate that. I will do my best to improve the game and consider your suggestions. Here is the first update.

Best regards,
Stefan

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Refine tutorial mode and add help section
[*] Allow tile placement on a restricted resource group
[*] Improve resource group information popup
[*] Enhance overall visuals, graphics, effects
[*] General improvements
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]
